title: Herbarium Lift
provenance: Original Postern rehearsal authored 27 September 2026. Fictional mechanisms; not Wrenmere canon. Difficulty is not human-calibrated.

intro.storyOn: A specimen tray is caught above the herbarium counter. Its accession number has survived a relabelling, but the little lift wants two occupied brackets and an exact balance. Work from the records, not the size of the weights.
intro.storyOff: Choose two weights, select the correct accession tray and lower it. Its dated return record supplies the service-return combination.

ending.storyOn: The tray reaches the counter and the service return opens. Both the physical balance and the date order came from the records you could inspect.
ending.storyOff: The tray reaches the counter and the service return opens. Both the physical balance and the date order came from the records you could inspect.

solution.storyOn: Fern+Ash=5, Ash+Ivy=8 and Fern+Ivy=7 give Fern=2, Ash=3, Ivy=5. Use Fern and Ash so both brackets are occupied and the total is 5. Accession 1909 belongs to the lower tray because it predates 1911. Lower that tray, then read return stamps oldest to newest: Birch 1904 stamp 3, Elm 1907 stamp 6, Cedar 1911 stamp 8. Enter 368.
solution.storyOff: Fern+Ash=5, Ash+Ivy=8 and Fern+Ivy=7 give Fern=2, Ash=3, Ivy=5. Use Fern and Ash so both brackets are occupied and the total is 5. Accession 1909 belongs to the lower tray because it predates 1911. Lower that tray, then read return stamps oldest to newest: Birch 1904 stamp 3, Elm 1907 stamp 6, Cedar 1911 stamp 8. Enter 368.

text.storyOn: Three weights are labelled Fern, Ash and Ivy. Reliable comparisons: Fern+Ash=5; Ash+Ivy=8; Fern+Ivy=7. The lift requires exactly 5 units AND two occupied brackets. Ivy alone would leave one bracket empty.
text.storyOff: Three weights are labelled Fern, Ash and Ivy. Reliable comparisons: Fern+Ash=5; Ash+Ivy=8; Fern+Ivy=7. The lift requires exactly 5 units AND two occupied brackets. Ivy alone would leave one bracket empty.

text.storyOn: The requested specimen was accessioned in 1909. Entries before 1911 are in the lower tray; 1911 and later entries are in the upper tray. The date, not the current plant name, identifies the tray.
text.storyOff: The requested specimen was accessioned in 1909. Entries before 1911 are in the lower tray; 1911 and later entries are in the upper tray. The date, not the current plant name, identifies the tray.

text.storyOn: Choose a bracket configuration. The remaining weights stay on the shelf. Replacing a configuration returns its previous weights, so none can be duplicated or lost.
text.storyOff: Choose a bracket configuration. The remaining weights stay on the shelf. Replacing a configuration returns its previous weights, so none can be duplicated or lost.
